_what: A RECORDED EXEMPTION from record-keeping rule 8 for the phaseA cluster campaign, and the reason it is an exemption rather than a fix.
record: ARG-164 (raised the two options), ARG-172 (this decision)
decision: RECORD THE EXEMPTION. Do not reconstruct.

why_no_card_can_be_completed.written_by: the cluster bundling step, at package time
why_no_card_can_be_completed.consumed_by: hpc/make_run_card.py for case_config (turbulence model, wall treatment), case_name, source_case and openfoam_version
why_no_card_can_be_completed.also_missing: the job log's provenance block, which is where git_commit at RUN TIME comes from

what_is_recoverable_and_what_is_not.geometry_sha256: RECOVERABLE. Each case's own constant/triSurface/wing.stl is on the cluster and can be hashed; that is the GEO-102 input gate and it reads the file snappyHexMesh actually used.
what_is_recoverable_and_what_is_not.turbulence_model_and_wall_treatment: RECOVERABLE. scripts/derive_run_card_fields.py reads them from constant/turbulenceProperties and 0/nut, and HALTS rather than relabelling an off-recipe value.
what_is_recoverable_and_what_is_not.openfoam_version: RECOVERABLE from the solver log's Build line.
what_is_recoverable_and_what_is_not.forces_residuals_mesh_metrics: RECOVERABLE from postProcessing and the checkMesh log, both of which survived the 2026-08-21 processor purge.
what_is_recoverable_and_what_is_not.git_commit_at_run_time: NOT RECOVERABLE. Nothing on disk recorded it, the runs are weeks old, and the repository has moved a long way since. There is no artefact from which it can be derived.

why_not_reconstruct: A reconstruction would produce cards that look complete while carrying ONE INVENTED FIELD. That is worse than an honest gap: a card is trusted precisely because every field in it was read from the case, and a single hand-authored provenance value silently voids that guarantee for the whole artefact. GEO-080 item 4 records run-card literals as a named instance of vouched success, and hand-writing a commit hash is the same defect in the field where it matters most. An exemption that says WHICH field is missing and WHY leaves the reader able to judge; a complete-looking card does not.

scope.exempt_note: These are the production runs whose numbers anyone would want to quote. The exemption does NOT make them quotable. It records that rule 8 blocks them for a MISSING PROVENANCE FILE rather than for any doubt about the values, so that the block is understood rather than mistaken for a quality verdict.
scope.no_card_note: Mesh, layer and wall-treatment DIAGNOSTICS. Their findings are already in the decision log as measured statements (ARG-117, ARG-118, ARG-125, ARG-126) and none of them produces a reportable aerodynamic coefficient, so no card was ever owed.

how_the_exemption_ends: Any case RE-RUN from now on gets a complete card, because hpc/submit.sh records the ARGUS_* environment as of 2026-08-21 (ARG-167) and the eight continuation jobs queued that day carry SUBMITTED_ENV.json. The exemption is therefore CLOSED-ENDED: it covers a fixed, named set of historical runs and nothing future.

counted.partition_note: These two buckets are asserted to cover every phaseA case that ever ran. A phaseA case in neither bucket is an omission and should be treated as a defect in this record (GEO-089).
